entities.name: Histidine-tRNA ligase
observations: The 434-residue query sequence is an exact sequence match to curated UniProt protein Q18DQ2 from Haloquadratum walsbyi.
Curated annotation assigns EC 6.1.1.21 and histidine-tRNA ligase activity.
Pfam matches include tRNA-synt_His (PF13393.12), tRNA-synt_2b (PF00587.31), and HGTP_anticodon (PF03129.26).

entities.name: Histidyl-tRNA aminoacylation
observations: Histidine-tRNA ligase catalyzes tRNA(His) + L-histidine + ATP → L-histidyl-tRNA(His) + AMP + diphosphate + H(+).
The reaction is mapped to Rhea RHEA:17313; EC classification is 6.1.1.21.

entities.name: Query protein sequence properties
observations: The query protein is 434 amino acids long with estimated molecular mass 47,811.58 Da and theoretical pI 4.287.
Sequence-derived properties are computational estimates and do not establish catalytic function independently.
